shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: A manual plunger. A soft plunge bounces off Flynn's divider into the scoop; a full plunge with the left flipper held in carries all the way around to the upper left flipper instead.

shots.name: Scoop
shots.notes: Flynn's Arcade. Holds the mystery award, starts Terminate Clu once C-L-U is lit, launches Light Cycle and Quorra Multiball, and is where every End of Line combo gets cashed in.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: The Light Cycle ramp, loopable indefinitely off the right flipper. The safest shot on the table at high speed, and the start of every End of Line combo.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Reached cleanly off the upper left flipper. A Clu shot, a Light Cycle jackpot shot, and the target of the game's hardest skill shot.

shots.name: Left Inner Loop
shots.notes: The Quorra spinner, feeding the upper left flipper. Unlimited jackpots during Quorra Multiball live here.

shots.name: Right Inner Loop
shots.notes: The Gem shot, just above the right ramp. Genuinely difficult to hit clean, but central to Follow Gem and to finishing Sea of Simulation.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Feeds into the pop bumpers more often than not. A Clu shot and part of the Find Flynn arrow's roaming path.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Relights the mystery award at the scoop with a single shot. Also a Clu shot.

shots.name: Recognizer Bank
shots.notes: The motorized three-target bank guarding the disc. All three targets act as one — any hit counts — and enough hits lower it to reveal the spinning disc behind.

shots.name: Disc
shots.notes: The spinning disc revealed once the Recognizer bank lowers. Feed it enough times to qualify Disc Multiball, then it's a jackpot shot in its own right once that multiball is running.

shots.name: Zuse Targets
shots.notes: Four standups spelling Z-U-S-E — two flanking the left ramp, one below the left pop bumper, one beside the scoop.

shots.name: Tron Targets
shots.notes: Four standups on the left spelling T-R-O-N. Light Double Scoring, Super Bumpers or Super Spinners depending on which is currently strobing.

shots.name: Clu Lanes
shots.notes: Three separate rollovers across both inlanes spelling C-L-U. Lighting all three readies Terminate Clu at the scoop.

shots.name: Zen Lane
shots.notes: A rollover switch just right of Flynn's divider. Starts the roaming Find Flynn arrow, and turns your next T-R-O-N target hit into an instant mode start.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Feed the usual bumper-value scoring, and get tripled outright during Super Bumpers.

shots.name: Upper Left Flipper
shots.notes: Receives a full-strength plunge and any shot that comes back down the right orbit. Lines up the right ramp and Gem shots that are otherwise awkward from below.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: The busiest flipper on the table — feeds the left ramp, the scoop, and both orbits.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the right ramp, the Gem loop and the left inner loop.

goals.title: Arcade Skill Shot
goals.summary: A soft plunge bounces off Flynn's divider and drops straight into the scoop for 500K, climbing 50K every time you collect it.

steps.action: Plunge softly so the ball bounces off Flynn's divider into the scoop
steps.detail: Too much power sends the ball past the divider instead of into the scoop. Landing it here also collects the mystery award that's lit at the start of every ball.

goals.title: Two More Ways To Start
goals.summary: The scoop skill shot is the easy choice, but two harder options are worth chasing when you're comfortable with the table.
goals.reward: 250K-300K, plus a Light Cycle insert either way
instructions: If the divider sends the ball right instead of into the scoop, it rolls down to the right flipper — one shot to the left ramp from there scores 250K, climbing 50K each time.

Hold the left flipper button in before you plunge and the orbit post stays down, carrying the ball all the way to the upper left flipper. Shoot the right ramp from there for 300K, climbing 50K each time — the hardest of the three, and worth less than the scoop besides.
Both of these also light a Light Cycle insert on the shot you used, on top of whatever the skill shot itself pays.

goals.title: Mystery Award
goals.summary: Lit at the start of every ball, and cheap to relight afterward — one clean shot to the right orbit is all it takes.
goals.reward: Points, Recognizer or Quorra progress, Clu or Gem progress, or a lit feature

steps.action: Shoot the scoop for the mystery award
steps.detail: Works during multiball too, not just single-ball play.

steps.action: Relight it with the right orbit
steps.detail: Just one shot here is enough to arm the next mystery award.

goals.title: End Of Line Combo
goals.summary: The single most valuable thing on the table, and the game never tells you so. Land any of the six major shots, then one-time it into the scoop before the ball settles.
goals.reward: 500K minimum, climbing with every combo you build

steps.action: Make any of the six major shots first
steps.detail: Both orbits, both ramps and both inner loops all count — their arrow inserts flash briefly right after you hit one.

steps.action: One-time it into the scoop
steps.detail: The value keeps climbing between collections and never resets on its own — but drain before you cash it in and it's gone, reset to 500K on the next ball.

goals.title: The Tron Modes
goals.summary: Three scoring boosts strobe at the T-R-O-N targets, and the Zen lane is the shortcut that makes starting all three in a row realistic.
instructions: The three modes strobe automatically at the T-R-O-N targets; hitting any target locks in whichever is currently flashing, and clearing all four starts it.
Double Scoring doubles every score on the table for its duration — by far the strongest of the three.
Super Bumpers and Super Spinners triple their respective shot's value instead.
Roll the Zen lane first and your very next T-R-O-N target hit starts the flashing mode instantly, no full bank clear required.
Banking several Zen rolls before you cash one in lets a single follow-up hit chain all three modes back to back.
Playing at least one mode flashes the Tron insert on the progress ladder; playing all three lights it solidly.

goals.title: Terminate Clu
goals.summary: Light all three C-L-U lanes across the inlanes and the scoop readies Terminate Clu — a timed run across four Clu-marked shots.
goals.reward: 250K for the first shot, 500K each after

steps.action: Light all three C-L-U lanes
steps.detail: Either inlane can light either letter — use the flipper buttons to move which one is currently flashing.

steps.action: Start Terminate Clu at the scoop
steps.detail: 25 seconds on the clock once it begins.

steps.action: Work the four Clu shots
steps.detail: Left orbit, left inner loop, right orbit and the scoop itself are all Clu shots. Relighting C-L-U mid-mode spots whichever of the four you haven't hit yet.

goals.title: Zuse Fast Scoring
goals.summary: Spell Z-U-S-E and the mode starts immediately — every switch on the table scores for 25 seconds, and the same targets can extend the clock while it runs.
goals.reward: 10K per switch, climbing with target hits

steps.action: Spell Z-U-S-E
steps.detail: Completing the bank a second time in a game needs all four hit again, starting the switch value at 15K instead of 10K.

steps.action: Keep hitting them once it's running
steps.detail: The first three hits each add 1K to the switch value; the fourth doesn't add value but resets the bank and adds ten seconds to the clock instead.

goals.title: Find Flynn
goals.summary: Roll the Zen lane and a red arrow starts roaming the table's six major shots. It isn't timed — the arrow just keeps moving until you catch it.

steps.action: Roll the Zen switch to start the hunt
steps.detail: This also flashes the Flynn insert on the progress ladder right away.

steps.action: Chase the roaming arrow
steps.detail: It moves across the left orbit, left ramp, left inner loop, right inner loop, right ramp and right orbit, reversing direction at each end.

goals.title: Follow Gem
goals.summary: Three shots to the Gem loop start it the first time, growing by two each time after. Once running, each repeat shot to the same loop pays 250K more than the last, from a 750K opener up to a 2.5M cap.

steps.action: Shoot the Gem loop enough times to start it
steps.detail: An Advance Gem or Start Gem mystery award can also count toward this.

steps.action: Keep looping Gem while it runs
steps.detail: 25 seconds on the clock by default, but the right orbit or left inner loop spinners each add ten more seconds, up to forty total — handy during multiball.

goals.title: Light Cycle Multiball
goals.summary: Light four of the six Light Cycle inserts and the scoop starts a fast, combo-heavy two-ball multiball built around one specific ramp-to-loop-to-ramp chain.
goals.reward: 350K per jackpot, 750K super, fixed double super

steps.action: Light four of the six Light Cycle inserts
steps.detail: Only four are needed the first time through — skip whichever two shots give you the most trouble.

steps.action: Start it at the scoop
steps.detail: Three shots stay lit for jackpots at a time; hitting one relights a different one instead of the same shot twice in a row.

steps.action: Chain ramp into loop into ramp for the big money
steps.detail: A left ramp jackpot flashes the Quorra insert at the left inner loop for a 750K super; following that up with the right ramp scores a fixed double super on top.

goals.title: Quorra Multiball
goals.summary: Five shots to the left inner loop qualify it, and the scoop starts a two-ball mode with unlimited jackpots and real add-a-ball potential.
goals.reward: 250K jackpots capped at 500K, a growing Super Jackpot

steps.action: Work the Quorra loop five times to qualify
steps.detail: Any number of spins on one visit still only counts as a single shot — give it a beat before sending the ball back through.

steps.action: Start it at the scoop
steps.detail: The Recognizer bank can add up to two more balls during the multiball, three hits at a time, for a full four-ball house.

steps.action: Keep collecting jackpots
steps.detail: 250K to start, climbing 50K until it caps at 500K — there's no limit on how many you can take.

steps.action: Cash the Super Jackpot at Gem
steps.detail: Worth a flat million plus everything added since the last Super. Double Scoring affects the jackpots, the Super's build-up, and the Super itself.

goals.title: Disc Multiball
goals.summary: The table's flagship multiball. Clear the Recognizer bank, feed the spinning disc to qualify, then work two full rounds of jackpots for the biggest Super Jackpot in the game.
goals.reward: 250K jackpots, 500K double jackpots, a multi-million Super

steps.action: Clear the Recognizer bank
steps.detail: Four hits the first time, whether they land on the bank directly or come from an Advance/Complete Recognizer mystery award.

steps.action: Feed the spinning disc seven times to qualify
steps.detail: The bank stays down and the disc spins loudly the whole time you're working toward this.

steps.action: Collect ten discs at the lit shots
steps.detail: Six shots carry the blue disc light; hitting one scores 250K, climbing 25K, and turns that shot off. Hitting the spinning disc itself only pays a flat 100K, but it relights every shot you've already turned off.

steps.action: Take three double jackpots when it rises again
steps.detail: Worth 500K apiece.

steps.action: Cash the Super Jackpot on the disc
steps.detail: Worth every disc and double jackpot collected this round — 2.5M at minimum, and well past 20M with Double Scoring running throughout.

goals.title: Sea Of Simulation
goals.summary: The safety net wizard mode. Get every progress-ladder insert at least flashing and the scoop opens a single untimed ball to finish off whatever's still incomplete.
goals.reward: 1M-9M in lump sums, plus a shot at every unfinished feature

steps.action: Start Sea Of Simulation
steps.detail: Only available once all nine ladder inserts are lit in some way but not every one is solid yet.

steps.action: Finish whichever features are still flashing
steps.detail: Flynn needs one scoop shot, Gem one loop shot, Clu and Zuse need each of their shots hit once, Quorra one inner loop shot, Disc and Light Cycle need each of their shots once, and Tron needs each T-R-O-N target. Every already-solid insert pays its lump sum immediately at the start, working up the ladder until it hits one that isn't solid yet.

goals.title: The Portal
goals.summary: Get all nine ladder inserts solidly lit and the scoop opens the real finale — a four-ball multiball with twenty-one jackpots spread across the whole table.
goals.reward: 500K climbing per jackpot, then a huge Super Jackpot

steps.action: Light and start The Portal
steps.detail: Worth a flat million just for reaching it, on top of whatever Sea of Simulation already paid out.

steps.action: Work through the rising insert ladder on each shot
steps.detail: Four shots start lit; each hit climbs the shot's own insert ladder, adds to the Super Jackpot, and raises that shot's value 50K, up to 1.5M.

steps.action: Collect the Super Jackpot
steps.detail: Available once every shot's ladder is cleared. After that, every major shot and the disc settle at a flat million apiece until the multiball ends.

goals.title: End Of Line Multiball
goals.summary: LE cabinets only. Spell D-A-F-T-P-U-N-K on the left ramp — twice — for a hidden extra ball and a bonus multiball that non-LE owners never see.
goals.reward: Extra ball, then a bonus multiball

steps.action: Spell D-A-F-T-P-U-N-K on LE machines
steps.detail: Every ramp shot adds a letter. Completing the word once lights an extra ball; completing it a second time lights End Of Line Multiball at the scoop.

steps.action: Start it at the scoop
steps.detail: Plays like Zuse Fast Scoring with a ball added in — every switch scores 10K, and disc hits add to that value. It doesn't advance any progress-ladder insert.

goals.title: End Of Ball Bonus
goals.summary: Built entirely from the progress ladder rather than switch counts — a flashing insert is worth 50K, a solid one 250K, and reaching the wizard modes pays out far more on top.
goals.reward: 50K base, climbing with every ladder insert you've touched
instructions: Every flashing insert on the ladder adds 50K to the bonus; every solidly lit one adds 250K.
Reaching Sea of Simulation adds a flat 450K for the rest of the game, and reaching The Portal adds 2.25M on top of that.
Every shot to the Gem loop adds another 1x to your bonus multiplier, on top of anything else running.
Double Scoring doubles the whole bonus if it's still active when the ball ends.

goals.title: Know Your Release Valves
goals.summary: Tron moves fast enough that having a safe shot to take under pressure matters as much as chasing points. The left ramp and the scoop are both built for exactly that.
goals.reward: Ball control, plus whatever the shot happens to pay

steps.action: Learn the left ramp as your release valve
steps.detail: It loops indefinitely off the right flipper and slows a fast ball down while still feeding an End of Line combo.

steps.action: Or dump it in the scoop from the left flipper
steps.detail: It's the single most important shot available from the left flipper for exactly this reason — there's almost always something useful lit there.

achievements.title: Relit
achievements.desc: Relight and collect the mystery award.

achievements.title: End Of Line
achievements.desc: Collect an End of Line combo jackpot.

achievements.title: Grid Champion
achievements.desc: Complete all three Tron modes in one game.

achievements.title: Fast Scoring
achievements.desc: Complete a full Zuse Fast Scoring run.

achievements.title: Found Him
achievements.desc: Find Flynn with the roaming arrow.

achievements.title: Maxed Out Gem
achievements.desc: Push a Follow Gem session all the way to its 2.5M cap.

achievements.title: Double Super
achievements.desc: Chain a Light Cycle Multiball ramp-to-loop-to-ramp for the double super jackpot.

achievements.title: Quorra's Super
achievements.desc: Collect a Quorra Multiball Super Jackpot.

achievements.title: Ten Discs
achievements.desc: Collect all ten discs in one Disc Multiball round.

achievements.title: Sea Of Simulation
achievements.desc: Reach and clear Sea of Simulation.

achievements.title: The Portal
achievements.desc: Light and start the final wizard mode.

achievements.title: Daft Punk
achievements.desc: Spell D-A-F-T-P-U-N-K twice on an LE machine.

drills.title: Soft, Sideways, Or All The Way
drills.text: Groove the soft plunge that bounces off Flynn's divider into the scoop, since that is the one worth the most. Then practise the other two: the divider sending you to the right flipper for a left ramp, and a full plunge with the left flipper held in that carries round to the upper left flipper for the right ramp.

drills.title: End Of Line Reps
drills.text: Take any of the six major shots — both ramps, both orbits, both inner loops — and one-time the return into the scoop before the ball settles anywhere. The value climbs between collections and never resets on its own, so the habit to build is cashing it in rather than saving it for a ball you might not finish.

drills.title: Two Release Valves
drills.text: When the ball is moving faster than you are, the left ramp off the right flipper and the scoop off the left flipper are the two places to send it. Play a whole ball taking one of those two every time you are not certain, and notice how rarely it actually costs you anything.

drills.title: Gem Loop Reps
drills.text: The loop above the right ramp is the hardest clean shot on the table, and Follow Gem is nothing but repeats of it. Work it from a cradled ball on the right flipper until you can string several together, because the value climbs 250K with every repeat.

drills.title: Count Quorra Visits, Not Spins
drills.text: Five shots qualify it, but any number of spins on one visit still counts as a single shot. Give the ball a beat on the upper left flipper before sending it back through, so you are banking five separate visits instead of one loud one.

drills.title: Ramp, Loop, Ramp
drills.text: During Light Cycle Multiball, take a left ramp jackpot and watch the Quorra insert flash at the left inner loop — that shot is a super. Follow it straight with the right ramp for a fixed double on top, and drill the three as one sequence rather than three separate decisions.

actionButton.how: Nothing on the lockdown bar — this landed a year before Stern started fitting action buttons. Shooter rod and flippers only, though holding the left flipper in before a full plunge is worth learning: it sends the ball the long way around to the upper flipper.

howItPlays.objective: Tron: Legacy is a fast Grid built on nine feature inserts and the combo the game never advertises -- End of Line, cashed at Flynn's scoop. Light every insert on the ladder to open the wizard modes: Sea of Simulation to mop up what you missed, then The Portal for the real finale.
loop: Bounce a soft plunge off Flynn's divider into the scoop to open the ball and grab the waiting mystery award.
Make any of the six major shots, then send the return on into the scoop before it can settle for an End of Line combo.
Strobe-lock a Tron mode at the T-R-O-N targets -- Double Scoring above all -- using the Zen lane to start it in a single hit.
Feed the Recognizer bank and the disc behind it for Disc Multiball, and qualify Light Cycle and Quorra at their loops for two more.
Light all nine ladder inserts to open the scoop for Sea of Simulation, then The Portal.

lights.name: C-L-U Lanes
lights.lit: Three rollovers spread across both inlanes spell C-L-U; a lit letter is one still open, and rolling a lit inlane banks it.

control.effect: either flipper button hops which C-L-U letter is flashing from one inlane to the other, so you can arm the letter you still need on whichever side the ball is about to come down
control.when: as the ball heads back toward the inlanes

lights.then: Spell all three and the scoop arms Terminate Clu, a countdown over four Clu-lit shots that pays 250K for the first and 500K for each one after. Relight C-L-U while the mode runs and it spots whichever of the four you still owe.

lights.name: T-R-O-N Targets
lights.lit: The four T-R-O-N standups gate three scoring boosts that strobe one at a time; hit any target to lock in whichever is flashing, then clear the bank to start it.
lights.flashing: Whichever boost is currently up -- Double Scoring, Super Bumpers or Super Spinners -- is the one a target hit locks in.
lights.then: Double Scoring doubles the whole table and is by far the strongest; the other two only triple their own shot. Take the Zen lane first and the very next target you hit fires the flashing boost on its own, and stacking a few Zen rolls lets one hit chain all three. The Zen lane also sets the roaming Find Flynn arrow loose.

lights.name: End Of Line Combo
lights.lit: Right after you make any of the six big shots -- the two ramps, the two orbits, the two inner loops -- its arrow flashes for a moment as the combo window.
lights.then: Snap that flash into the scoop while the ball is still live and you bank an End of Line combo -- quietly the biggest single earner here, though nothing on the display ever says as much. The value climbs with each one and never slides back on its own -- but let it drain before you cash in and it is wiped down to a half million on the next ball.

lights.name: Light Cycle Inserts
lights.lit: The left ramp is the Light Cycle ramp, loopable all day off the right flipper; lighting four Light Cycle inserts out of the six arms the multiball at the scoop, so you can leave out the two shots you like least.
lights.then: Start it at the scoop for a fast two-ball run built around one chain: a left ramp jackpot lights the Quorra super over at the inner loop, and an immediate right ramp piles a fixed double on top of it.

lights.name: Quorra Loop
lights.lit: The left inner loop is the Quorra spinner; five separate visits qualify the multiball, and spinning it many times on one trip still earns just a single visit, so give it a beat between shots.
lights.then: Fire it up at the scoop for a two-ball mode with no ceiling on jackpots -- the Recognizer bank can bolt on up to two more balls for a full house of four -- and cash the growing Super over at the Gem loop.

lights.name: Recognizer & Disc
lights.lit: The motorized Recognizer bank guards the spinning disc -- all three of its targets act as one, so any hit chips away -- and enough hits drop it to expose the disc, which you then feed enough times over to qualify Disc Multiball.
lights.then: This is the table's flagship: work two full rounds -- collect ten discs across the lit shots, then three double jackpots when the bank rises again -- and cash a Super on the disc that dwarfs everything else, well past twenty million with Double Scoring going.

lights.name: Gem Loop
lights.lit: The Gem loop sits just above the right ramp and is the trickiest clean shot the table has; a few shots to it start Follow Gem, and every Gem shot also adds a notch to your end-of-ball bonus multiplier.
lights.then: Keep hammering the loop while the mode runs -- every extra loop is worth 250K over the one before, climbing to a two-and-a-half-million ceiling -- and lean on it late, since finishing Sea of Simulation wants a Gem shot too. Spinner passes stretch the clock.

lights.name: Flynn's Scoop
lights.lit: Flynn's Arcade scoop holds the mystery award, lit as every ball starts and cheap to relight afterward -- a single right-orbit shot arms the next one.
lights.then: It is also the table's safety valve and the cash-in point for End of Line combos, Terminate Clu and every multiball start, so from the left flipper there is nearly always something worth dropping in for.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Either flipper button hops the flashing C-L-U letter from one inlane to the other, so tap it as the ball returns to arm the letter you still need on the side it is coming down. Lighting all three C-L-U rollovers readies Terminate Clu at the scoop, the timed four-shot run that is the payoff. The T-R-O-N modes, by contrast, auto-strobe and are locked in by a target hit rather than the flippers.

scoring.text: Groove the soft plunge that kisses Flynn's divider into the scoop -- 500K and the mystery award in one -- and learn the two harder starts: the divider kicking right toward a left-ramp shot, and a held-flipper full plunge carried round to the upper flipper for the right ramp. Then start banking End of Line combos, the quiet best score on the table.

Work the feature ladder: strobe-lock Double Scoring at the T-R-O-N targets, spell Z-U-S-E for a switch-scoring frenzy, run down the roaming Find Flynn arrow, and start the three multiballs -- Light Cycle, Quorra and the flagship Disc. Stack Double Scoring under a multiball and the jackpots balloon.

Everything points at the ladder's two ends. Get all nine inserts at least flashing and the scoop opens Sea of Simulation, an untimed ball that pays out your solid inserts and lets you finish the rest. Drive all nine solid and the scoop opens The Portal -- a four-ball finale spraying twenty-one jackpots across the table into one enormous Super. On LE cabinets, spelling the Daft Punk name on the left ramp twice over hides an extra ball and a bonus multiball on top.
